scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide city street with a large building on the right side and a smaller one on the left side. The street has a few trees lining both sides and a bike lane in the middle. There are no cars or pedestrians visible in the image. The sky is mostly cloudy but there are some patches of blue sky visible through the gaps in the clouds. The street is paved with asphalt and has white lines painted on it to guide traffic flow. The buildings are tall and have balconies on each floor. The larger building on the right has a rounded corner and is tan colored with brown accents. The smaller building on the left is also tan but has more windows than the other. There are several trees planted along the sidewalk in front of the buildings. The street is empty except for a few objects such as a bike rack and a trash can. The ground is made up of asphalt and has white markings on it. The overall atmosphere is calm and peaceful.
